pages.text: Ogre Mages turn the battlefield poisonous. Their bogfume threatens intruders while empowering Grunts that remain inside it.$(br2)Do not let a crowd settle comfortably in the fog. A defeated Mage may leave behind the Bogfume Charm that shaped its craft.
When the air turns green, reposition before the whole warband benefits.

pages.title: Mire Jaws
pages.text: The Mage slams its staff into the ground and a line of jaws snaps up out of the mire toward you, one after another. Watch the stone in the staff: it glows just before each cast. Move sideways when it does.$(br2)It also smacks nearby enemies with the staff and shoves them back with a burst of magic. Its robe hides its legs, so listen for its steps.
